children: Cullinan Therapeutics announced planned Q4 2026 data readouts for CLN-978, velinotamig and CLN-049.
CLN-978: Multi-dose and single target dose regimen data for SLE, RA and Sjögren’s disease to be shared in December.
Velinotamig: Multi-dose regimen data from a Phase 1 dose-escalation study in SLE to be presented at ACR Convergence on Nov 8.
CLN-049: Updated dose-escalation Phase 1 data in relapsed/refractory AML planned for release in December.
Press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1; Item 7.01 information is furnished, not filed, and not incorporated by reference.
